create_minigrid_environment: create a MiniGridEnv subclass and implement _gen_grid to build a custom 2D grid world environment
step_agent_action: step the agent forward in the grid environment using env.step(action) to get observation and reward
encode_grid_state: encode the grid into a compact numpy array using Grid.encode() for serialization or observation generation
decode_grid_array: decode a numpy array back into a Grid object using Grid.decode() to reconstruct the environment state
render_grid_view: render the grid environment visually using env.render(mode='human') to display the agent and grid tiles
